# E0610: malformed profile

A release build reads a profile whole or not at all. Fix the line, or delete the profile and write it again with `stilt run --profile`.

- Rule: [`builds.profile-form`](../../reference/20-builds.md#builds.profile-form)
- Reported at: the line, from its first character to its last.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0610_malformed_profile.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0610_malformed_profile.lt):

`E0610_malformed_profile.lt`:

```stilt fragment
// A profile whose second line counts 3, which isn't a power of two (builds.profile-form).

fn main() / io {
  for i in 0..3 { print("{i}") }
}
```

`E0610_malformed_profile.profile`, beside it:

```text
main.main/body 0000 entry 1:16 1
main.main/body 0000 loop 2:3 3
```

What `stilt check` prints for it:

```text
── MALFORMED PROFILE ────────────── E0610_malformed_profile.profile:2:1  [E0610]

Line 2 of the profile isn't of its form: `3` isn't a count, a power of two:

  2 │ main.main/body 0000 loop 2:3 3
    │ ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

A release build reads a profile whole or not at all. Fix the line, or delete the
profile and write it again with `stilt run --profile`.
```
